Local vendor identification assets
===================================

The SVG artwork in this directory is copied from Simple Icons 16.36.0, released under the terms in SIMPLE-ICONS-LICENSE.md. The source URLs and brand color values are recorded in the upstream package data. The individual icon license fields were not supplied for these entries; Simple Icons explicitly warns that its project license does not automatically license every icon. The marks are shown only to identify device vendors. Vendor names and marks remain trademarks of their respective owners; this project does not imply endorsement. Check each vendor's current brand terms before redistributing this application.

Included upstream entries: Cisco (cisco), MikroTik (mikrotik), Juniper Networks (junipernetworks), Fortinet (fortinet), Huawei (huawei), Ubiquiti (ubiquiti), Dell (dell), and Palo Alto Networks (paloaltonetworks). Models without a mapped local asset use the generic network-device icon.
